أكتفي (form VIII)
# أَكْتَفِي (ʔaktafī) /ʔak.ta.fiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# أَكْتَفِيَ (ʔaktafiya) /ʔak.ta.fi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
